purpose: compose capability-checked ownership, sparse routing, and four configured BRAM/URAM banks into one local-memory subsystem

structure.command_bram: not part of this subsystem or bank namespace

public_interfaces.mm2s: 128-bit write with logical bank ID 0 1 or 2
public_interfaces.sa_out: 1024-bit read and write fixed to bank3

address_units.sa_act_read_addr: 256-bit bank1 read words; one read word spans two consecutive 128-bit write words

capability_gate.request_pulse_rule: each acquire and release vector is a one-cycle transaction pulse and must not remain asserted for replay
capability_gate.atomicity: all requested acquire entries pass to the ownership table or none pass
capability_gate.invalid: BANK_NONE, out-of-range, owner zero, unknown owner, or unsupported owner-bank pair latches a subsystem error and cannot modify ownership
capability_gate.release: inactive or unsupported owner-bank release vectors are rejected atomically before the ownership table; matching active releases retain child-table owner checking

error_policy.memory_no_touch: a rejected ownership or router request cannot assert any memory ena enb or write enable

integration_rules: child RTL is instantiated without modification
memory contents persist across valid release and reacquire owner transitions
response data is consumed only when its response valid is asserted
all memories and router use synchronous active-low reset and one common clock
READ_LATENCY is exactly 3 end to end
BANK_NONE entries 4 through 15 never instantiate memory and can never become busy

required_cases: reset clears ownership response-valid and all errors
invalid BANK_NONE and unsupported owner-bank atomic acquire do not change any busy bit
MM2S writes bank1 then release and SA_ACT reacquire reads exact combined 256-bit payload
MM2S writes bank2 then release and SA_WGT reacquire reads exact 128-bit payload
SA_OUT writes bank3 then release and S2MM reacquire reads exact 1024-bit payload
bank1 ACT and bank2 WGT read concurrently with exact latency3 responses
SA_OUT bank3 read and write concurrent behavior matches BRAM read_first contract
wrong-owner release faults and preserves ownership
bank zero is writable and ownership-reusable
rejected router access asserts no physical memory enable
source closure contains exactly the frozen children and no behavioral memory substitute
OOC synthesis reports actual aggregate BRAM and URAM mapping and 200MHz timing

blocked_dependencies: design-specific dispatcher must use bank_config_pkg capability checks before executor command acceptance
DataMover adapters and systolic-array ports are not connected in this packet
post-route timing and physical-board validation remain required
